headerDisplay: Unofficial plugin. Your Somfy password is stored in plain text in Homebridge's config.json; protect that file accordingly.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the platform in the Homebridge log.

username.title: Username
username.description: Your Somfy Protect account username (the e-mail used in the Somfy Protect app).

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Somfy Protect account password. Note: it is stored in plain text in config.json.

clientId.title: OAuth client ID
clientId.description: Optional. Overrides the built-in Somfy client ID. Must be set together with the client secret.

clientSecret.title: OAuth client secret
clientSecret.description: Optional. Overrides the built-in Somfy client secret. Must be set together with the client ID.

siteIds.title: Site IDs
siteIds.description: Optional. By default every home (site) of your Somfy account is added. To add only some of them, list their site IDs here. Available site IDs are listed in the plugin logs.
